name: phase1-synthetic-sample
description: Synthetic sample railway network for YatraLink Phase 1 engine tests. These are NOT Indian Railways schedules and the train numbers are invented (prefixed YT).
scenarios: invalid connection (20 minutes and 29 minutes against a 30 minute minimum)
connection exactly at the minimum buffer
more than two train changes (AAA to EEE needs four)
different-station transfer (NDLS to DEL) with an explicit allowance
